sentence_stem: Had the committee been consulted earlier,
correct_completion: the project would have avoided these delays.
full_sentence: Had the committee been consulted earlier, the project would have avoided these delays.
acceptable_variants: the project would have been on schedule.
we would have avoided these delays.

options.text: the project would be finished by now.
options.why_wrong: This mixes time references. 'By now' signals the present, but the stem refers to a past condition and needs a past result.

options.text: the project would have avoided these delays.
the committee had not been asked anything.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the idea of the stem but does not give the result clause the 'would have' structure that the inverted conditional requires.

options.text: delays were what the committee wanted.
options.why_wrong: This states what the committee wanted. It does not form a conditional result linked to the earlier consultation.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'Had + subject + past participle'
explanation: The inverted form 'Had + subject + past participle' replaces 'If + subject + had + past participle'. The main clause must then use 'would have' plus a past participle to express a past result that did not happen.
